description: Produce the operator-facing remediation the user must run against LIVE D1 (which the agent cannot touch): (1) a schema-corrective SQL script that rebuilds the live dropdown_lists table so its `id` is `INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT` again, matching mgmt/db/schema/core.sql, preserving all existing rows; and (2) the cleanup SQL to revert the test edit made to row id=1 during live QA (Category 'Lighting QA5476'/'लाइटिंग' back to 'Lighting'/'रोशनी'). Documentation/SQL only — no live execution. This matters because FEAT-002's meta.changes guard converts silent-no-op writes into visible 400s, BUT (confirmed during FEAT-002 reproduction) the exact live variant — a plain `id INTEGER` that lost AUTOINCREMENT — makes an INSERT report changes=1 while storing id=NULL, which meta.changes cannot catch; the durable fix for that is restoring the correct DDL. CRITICAL PLACEMENT CONSTRAINT (discovered by the orchestrator): this corrective SQL must NOT be added as a numbered file under mgmt/db/migration/2026-09-05/ (or any migration folder). The test mgmt/backend/test/h10-m38-indexes-and-retention.test.mjs enforces that EVERY migration file (a) has a SCHEMA_FOR_MIGRATION entry, (b) applies against the committed schema AND is idempotent on a second apply, and (c) unless in a narrow exemption set contains no DROP/DELETE/UPDATE/ALTER. A CREATE-new / INSERT-SELECT / DROP / ALTER RENAME rebuild satisfies none of those and would break that test and the drift/matrix guards. So deliver it as a standalone operator runbook doc + .sql under the existing cleanup area, NOT as a migration.
steps: Create a NEW operator directory mgmt/db/cleanup/2026-09-17-dropdown-lists-id-fix/ (date-stamped like the existing 2026-09-14-reset-portal-data/). Do NOT put anything under mgmt/db/migration/.

In that dir, write fix-dropdown-lists-id.sql: the SQLite table-rebuild following the documented pattern in mgmt/db/migration/2026-09-05/12-column-types-integer.sql PART 2. Contents (real, runnable statements): `CREATE TABLE dropdown_lists_new ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, list_type TEXT, english_value TEXT, hindi_label TEXT, active TEXT, sort_order INTEGER );` then `INSERT INTO dropdown_lists_new (id, list_type, english_value, hindi_label, active, sort_order) SELECT id, list_type, english_value, hindi_label, active, sort_order FROM dropdown_lists;` then `DROP TABLE dropdown_lists;` then `ALTER TABLE dropdown_lists_new RENAME TO dropdown_lists;` then `CREATE INDEX idx_dropdown_lists_list_type ON dropdown_lists(list_type);` and `CREATE INDEX idx_dropdown_lists_active ON dropdown_lists(active);`. Carrying id forward preserves references (e.g. row id=1 Lighting). Put a large leading comment block: root cause (id lost INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT via the reset RUNBOOK 'If something goes wrong' restore path, which replays `wrangler d1 export` output); a WARNING to back up first (per the reset RUNBOOK step 0); the exact apply command `npx wrangler d1 execute chhath-core --remote --file mgmt/db/cleanup/2026-09-17-dropdown-lists-id-fix/fix-dropdown-lists-id.sql`; and a NOTE that a database freshly built from schema/core.sql is ALREADY correct and must NOT run this.

In the same dir write RUNBOOK.md: step-by-step for the user — (0) back up chhath-core (`npx wrangler d1 export chhath-core --remote --output backup-core-$(date +%F).sql`); (1) PRE-FLIGHT detection: `npx wrangler d1 execute chhath-core --remote --command "SELECT sql FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table' AND name='dropdown_lists';"` and only proceed if the printed CREATE TABLE lacks `PRIMARY KEY` on id; (2) apply fix-dropdown-lists-id.sql; (3) POST-CHECK: re-run the detection query and confirm `id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT` is present, and `SELECT COUNT(*) FROM dropdown_lists;` matches the pre-count; (4) verify ADD now works in the mgmt UI (add a throwaway Category item, confirm it appears after reload, then delete it); (5) note that the mgmt worker code fix (FEAT-002) is deployed separately via `git pull && npx wrangler deploy` in mgmt/backend and does not depend on this SQL, but both together fully resolve the bug.

In the same dir write RESTORE-lighting-row.md (or fold into RUNBOOK.md as a clearly-titled section): the exact revert of the QA test edit — `UPDATE dropdown_lists SET english_value='Lighting', hindi_label='रोशनी' WHERE id=1 AND list_type='Category';` with apply command `npx wrangler d1 execute chhath-core --remote --command "UPDATE dropdown_lists SET english_value='Lighting', hindi_label='रोशनी' WHERE id=1 AND list_type='Category';"`, stating this reverts a value that live QA changed from 'Lighting'/'रोशनी' to 'Lighting QA5476'/'लाइटिंग', and noting it can alternatively be fixed via the now-working Edit UI. Run this AFTER the id-fix (or independently — it works regardless).

Optionally add a lightweight test asserting the corrective SQL is valid and yields the correct end-state DDL WITHOUT registering it as a migration: e.g. mgmt/backend/test/dropdown-lists-id-fix.test.mjs that loads mgmt/db/cleanup/2026-09-17-dropdown-lists-id-fix/fix-dropdown-lists-id.sql via readFileSync, builds a drifted table (id plain INTEGER) seeded with a couple rows incl id=1, applies the script through node:sqlite, and asserts: dropdown_lists now has id as INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (PRAGMA table_info shows pk=1 on id), the rows survived with ids intact (id=1 still present), and a fresh INSERT omitting id now gets a real autoincrement id (not NULL). This proves the operator script works and guards it from rotting. Keep it OUT of the migration folder so the migration guards do not pick it up.

Run the full mgmt/backend suite and the specific guard tests to confirm nothing regressed: schema-is-the-end-state.test.mjs, h10-m38-indexes-and-retention.test.mjs, migration-matrix.test.mjs, migration-target-databases.test.mjs, pr35-migration-ledger.test.mjs must all stay green (since we added NO migration, they should be unaffected).
acceptance_criteria: A standalone operator script mgmt/db/cleanup/2026-09-17-dropdown-lists-id-fix/fix-dropdown-lists-id.sql rebuilds dropdown_lists with id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, preserves all rows (ids carried forward), and recreates both indexes, with a header documenting backup, apply command, root cause, pre-flight detection, and the fresh-DB-not-needed note.
A RUNBOOK.md in the same dir gives the ordered backup -> detect -> apply -> post-check -> UI-verify procedure.
The revert of QA row id=1 to 'Lighting'/'रोशनी' is documented with an exact, copy-pasteable wrangler command.
Nothing was added under mgmt/db/migration/; the migration guard tests (h10-m38, migration-matrix, migration-target-databases, pr35-migration-ledger) and schema-is-the-end-state all still pass.
Full suite `node --test --test-reporter=spec test/*.test.mjs` passes with 0 failures.

If the optional validation test is added, it lives in mgmt/backend/test/ (not the migration folder) and passes, proving the corrective script produces the correct DDL and restores autoincrement inserts.
verification: cd mgmt/backend && PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH" node --test --test-reporter=spec test/h10-m38-indexes-and-retention.test.mjs test/migration-matrix.test.mjs test/migration-target-databases.test.mjs test/pr35-migration-ledger.test.mjs test/schema-is-the-end-state.test.mjs
findings: Delivered operator remediation under mgmt/db/cleanup/2026-09-17-dropdown-lists-id-fix/ (NOT a migration, so migration guards do not scan it): (1) fix-dropdown-lists-id.sql — table rebuild restoring id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT, carries all columns incl id forward via INSERT...SELECT, DROP old, RENAME, recreates idx_dropdown_lists_list_type + idx_dropdown_lists_active, matching mgmt/db/schema/core.sql exactly; header documents root cause, backup warning, exact apply command, and the fresh-DB-not-needed note. (2) RUNBOOK.md — ordered backup -> pre-flight detection -> apply -> post-check -> UI verify -> separate FEAT-002 worker deploy note; folds the QA revert (row id=1 'Lighting QA5476'/'लाइटिंग' back to 'Lighting'/'रोशनी') into a titled 'Restore the QA-edited row id=1' section with the exact wrangler --command form and the Edit-UI alternative. (3) mgmt/backend/test/dropdown-lists-id-fix.test.mjs — validation test (in test/, not migration folder) that readFileSync-loads the fix SQL, applies it via node:sqlite DatabaseSync to a drifted table (id plain INTEGER seeded incl id=1), and asserts id becomes INTEGER PRIMARY KEY (pk=1, DDL matches AUTOINCREMENT), rows survive with ids intact (id=1 'Lighting'), a fresh INSERT omitting id gets a real non-null autoincrement id, and both indexes are recreated. VERIFICATION: guard tests (h10-m38-indexes-and-retention, migration-matrix, migration-target-databases, pr35-migration-ledger, schema-is-the-end-state) + new test = 78 pass / 0 fail. Full suite node --test test/*.test.mjs = 1078 pass / 0 fail (1075 prior + 3 new). node:sqlite ExperimentalWarning is expected noise. No files added under mgmt/db/migration/.
